systems.system: Mass biometric enrolment solution (national ID rollout)
systems.platform: Laxton enrolment kits (iris, face, fingerprint; work with or without internet); IN Groupe database management system
systems.tiers: 2,500 kits; January 2026 pilot through 116 registration centres in 26 communes

note: A national identity enrolment operation; communes are where registration centres sat, with nothing on the commune offices' connection.
